# Removed

The Product · N mini-editors and ghost overlays are gone. Next-action scores
show up inside the real editor (`index.html`): the add-node menu, the menu
that opens when a wire is dropped on empty canvas, and the model picker.
A confident “wire” score only emphasizes a compatible port while you drag;
dropping still uses the editor’s normal connect path.

`?na=0` or `?product=off` turns the hints off. With the predictor unavailable,
those menus look the same as they did before.
